description: LightGroup surface hidden (gate-off). The resident-card light group is driven by sta_residentCardShow, which is set to CARD_LIGHTGROUP only when val_residentCard==CARD_LIGHTGROUP. However val_residentCard is hard-coded to 1 (CARD_CURRENTTIME) under the ALWASYS_SHOW_UI else-branch at diAEControl.cpp L122 and is never assigned any other value, so sta_residentCardShow can never equal CARD_LIGHTGROUP and the light-group Draw/SetData body early-returns without producing a texture. The surface therefore cannot be shown through the can[]/mem[]/someip harness. This case holds the remaining surfaces at their own non-show states and asserts the negative label, documenting the LightGroup surface as undrivable until the val_residentCard origin is re-based.
